# T-3: Align review prompts

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make implementation, reviewer, and triage prompts share the same blocking failure modes and non-blocking policy.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The impl reviewer system prompt includes the R2 blocking modes and JSON output schema.
- `src/flow/prompts/impl/review.md` tells the implementer to apply blocking findings and treat non-blocking improvements as context-based triage.
- `src/flow/prompts/impl/implement.md` tells implementers to satisfy the R2 blocking modes before review.
- `src/flow/prompts/task/review.md` uses the same structured blocking/non-blocking policy for task-scoped review.
- Previous impl review memory is included in later reviewer prompts with explicit array and character bounds.

## Implementation Notes
Touch `src/flow/commands/review.js`, `src/flow/prompts/impl/review.md`, `src/flow/prompts/impl/implement.md`, and `src/flow/prompts/task/review.md`. After prompt source changes, run `sdd-forge upgrade` to refresh generated skill assets.

## Test Strategy
Unit or spec-local tests that inspect prompt source for the shared blocking labels and previous memory bounds; covered by R10, R11, R12, R16, and R17.
